PFPI

LOBOS WIN WEEK 8 TITLE WITH SEASON-BEST 12-2;
MANIACS MAINTAIN NARROWEST OF SEASON LEADS

Greg’s Lobos won the PFPI Week 8 title alone with a season-best 12-2 mark, while Mom’s Maniacs maintained her 1-game overall lead, but with Tati’s Llamas now in second place.

Christie’s Ferraris cashed the week’s lone Unique Hit, collecting a coveted Coonskin for the Broncos victory.

PFPI’s 23rd season of the modern era is now eight weeks down and 10 to go -- nearing the midpoint of the long climb for the Dad’s Dynamics Cup championship trophy.
